items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
items.translation: 指示某些其他对象是否“等于”当前对象。如果另一个对象与当前对象属于同一类，且所有记录组件均相等，则这两个对象相等。引用组件使用Objects::equals(Object,Object)进行比较；基本类型组件则使用其对应包装类中的compare方法进行比较。
